scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem concerns the specific volume-preserving Steiner linear parameter system used in the lead source; it is not asserted for every continuous symmetrization flow.
No strict concavity, equality classification, or set inclusion between generalized polar projection bodies at different parameters is claimed.
The positive-density-concavity cases use the support-based Borell--Brascamp--Lieb formulation: the joint admissible support is convex and the density is gamma-concave on that support.
The universal result is analytic; no finite computation is used to infer the all-parameter statement.
Targeted searches found no covering statement, but an unindexed historical shadow-system formulation cannot be excluded.
title: Concavity along the Steiner chord for generalized polar projection measures
